common_intent_requirements.text: 一根均匀、能绕中央支点自由转动的平衡木
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 一根均匀、能绕中央支点自由转动的平衡木
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a uniform balance beam that rotates freely around its central pivot.
Its two ends are equally distant from the pivot and remain fully visible.
two identical wooden blocks are placed at one end
one matching wooden block is placed at the other end.
The end carrying two blocks descends while the end carrying one block rises.

physics_checks.criterion: 在等臂、同样配重单元且无额外约束时，较重的一侧产生向下倾斜趋势。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 支点、两端距离与三块同样木块可辨，撤去扶持后可见倾斜方向。
fail_examples: 较轻的一侧无额外外力却持续下压较重的一侧
支点随梁平移或穿过梁
较重一侧的木块凭空消失使其变轻
not_required: 不测角加速度或最终倾角
碰到限位或地面后停止可以合理

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
